annotation: The participant brought their right hand up to touch their nose, extended their left hand forward and upward, palm down, and their eyes were closed.
The participant leaned back slightly, closed their eyes, smiled and clasped their hands together in a pleading gesture.
The participant grooved along to the rhythm, looked to their left, and grinned, their eyes narrowing slightly.
The participant spread both arms wide, turned their head to the left, and looked up with wide eyes.
